# uwuFlights

> Free, worldwide, point-and-search live aircraft tracking progressive web
> app for plane spotters. Detects the user's location (GPS or manual
> latitude/longitude) and shows live nearby aircraft on a compass-style
> radar view or a sortable list, with distance, altitude, speed, and
> bearing. Users can favourite individual flights (by callsign) or
> aircraft types (by ICAO type code), synced across devices when signed
> in, or stored on-device otherwise. Installable, and usable fully
> offline after the first visit.

uwuFlights is a single-page application; there are no separate content
pages to crawl beyond the root URL. This file exists to summarise what the
app does and how it works for language models and other automated
readers.

## Key facts

- Live aircraft data comes from two sources, queried by point and radius:
  adsb.lol as the primary source, and OpenSky Network as an automatic
  fallback if adsb.lol is unavailable.
- Default theme is light mode with a mint green (#ccffcc) brand colour;
  users can switch between light/dark mode and seven brand colour options
  from the theme button in the header.
- Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, deployed on Vercel with
  serverless API proxy functions, and an optional Supabase backend for
  cross-device favourites.
- Not affiliated with any airline, airport, or aviation authority; this is
  an independent, community, plane-spotting tool built by Augy Studios.
